as_of_content:
[[File:Gold.png|thumb|right]]

'''Gold''' is the standard currency in the game.

Gold is used to upgrade and rank up Bots and Mods, to start [[Away Mission]]s, to start [[Arena]] fights, to start Alliance Missions (formerly), and to upgrade [[Masteries]].

Gold can be earned by completing fights and in all game modes, from successfully completing [[Away Mission]]s, helping other [[Commander]]s in an [[Alliance]] with help requests, from some [[Alliance Quest]]s, from certain [[crystal]]s like the Arena Crystal and the Gold Crystal, Daily Deals, duplicate Bots and Mods, and [[Forge|Forging]].

[[File:23376356 189518801609868 6058695352862655587 n.jpg|thumb|273x273px|left|List with Cost/Sell value of Gold for all modes in-game (411Bot)]]
